full_prompt_en: A square experimental photographic image shows the side profile of a person emerging from a deep navy field as a dense constellation of tiny blue and gold lights. The background is almost uniform dark blue, with no visible room, horizon, or other setting. The figure occupies the central portion from head to the lower edge, facing toward the right. A rounded upper head shape rises near the top, while a projecting nose and chin break the right outline. Across the left side of the head, a thin luminous strand extends horizontally like a loose filament. Warm yellow-orange light catches the outer contour of the face, neck, and upper shoulder, then flares more strongly along the right side of the head and the central chest. The interior of the figure is much darker, made of scattered blue specks and fine short threads rather than a solid surface. Near the lower right, a rounded shoulder and upper torso are thick with grain-like sparks; their edges dissolve into the black-blue surroundings. Fine curling lines radiate from the profile and shoulders, making the boundary restless and porous. The light does not behave like a single conventional lamp. Instead, golden points appear to shine through the outer fibers, while cooler blue pinpricks hover inside the shadowed mass. The darkest navy area to the left gives the warm rim plenty of empty space, and the right side of the image remains largely unoccupied beyond the illuminated profile. Surface detail resembles long-exposure light, airborne particles, or exposed fibers, yet the figure stays legible through its continuous silhouette. There is no readable writing or hard physical ground. The overall composition sets a warm, flickering outline against profound cool darkness, creating an ethereal sense of a human form held together by scattered light.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形实验性摄影影像呈现一个人的侧面轮廓，从深海军蓝色场域中浮现，形体由密集的微小蓝色与金色光点构成。背景几乎是均匀的深蓝，没有可见房间、地平线或其他场景。人物从头部延伸到下缘，占据画面中央，面向右侧。圆润的头顶靠近上方，突出的鼻子与下巴打断右侧轮廓。头部左侧有一道细亮的丝状痕迹水平伸出，像松散的纤维。暖黄橙色光抓住面部、颈部和上肩的外缘，在头部右侧和胸口中央更强地闪亮。形体内部暗得多，由零散蓝色亮点和细短光丝组成，而不是实体表面。右下附近，圆转的肩膀与上身布满颗粒般火花；边缘融入黑蓝色环境。细小卷曲线条从侧影和肩部向外散开，使界线显得活跃而多孔。光并不像来自一盏普通灯。相反，金色亮点仿佛透过外缘纤维发亮，较冷的蓝色针点则悬浮在暗形内部。左侧最深的海军蓝给暖色轮廓留下宽阔空处，图像右侧在被照亮的侧影之外也大致空着。表面细节让人联想到长曝光光迹、漂浮粒子或暴露纤维，但连续剪影仍令人物可辨。画中没有可读文字或坚实地面。整体构图让温暖闪烁的轮廓置于深重冷暗之上，营造一个由散落光点维系的人形所带来的空灵感。
style_prompt_en: The experimental photographic look builds forms from fine luminous particles and hair-thin filaments rather than solid filled planes. A deep navy and near-black field absorbs most light, allowing sparse electric blue points and stronger gold-orange rims to define mass. Edges remain porous and restless: some strands flare outward, while other points recede into the interior shadow. Warm and cool light occupy distinct layers, so a bright contour can sit over a darker, speckled core. Broad negative space makes each filament more visible and keeps the clustered center from feeling visually crowded. The apparent glow has no hard shadow or conventional material reflection; its depth comes from changing particle density and selective brightness. The overall effect is spectral and tactile at once, with a recognizable volume suspended inside an otherwise minimal dark field.
style_prompt_zh: 这种实验性摄影观感以细密发光粒子和发丝般光线构成形体，而非实心平面。深海军蓝与近黑色场域吸收大部分光，让稀疏电蓝色点和更强的金橙色外缘界定体量。边缘多孔而活跃：有些光丝向外迸出，另一些亮点退入内部阴影。暖光与冷光占据不同层次，因此明亮轮廓可以覆在更暗、布满微粒的核心之上。宽阔留白使每根细丝更显眼，也让集中的中心不至于拥挤。表面光辉没有坚硬投影或常规材料反射；纵深来自粒子密度与局部亮度的变化。整体效果既幽灵般又具有触感，一个可辨体积悬置在其余极简的暗色场域中。
theme_en: A side-facing human silhouette formed from glowing gold and blue points of light
theme_zh: 由金色与蓝色光点构成的侧身人物剪影
name: Christopher Bucklow
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
